topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: It welcomes students and outlines the learning objectives and scope for the lecture on cancer therapy.

topics.label: Surgery, Radiotherapy, and Cytotoxic Chemotherapy
topics.groupedBecause: They describe the mechanisms, applications, and systemic toxicities of traditional cancer therapies, including surgical resection, irradiation, and cytotoxic drugs.

topics.label: Exploiting Specific Cellular Vulnerabilities and Checkpoint Defects
topics.groupedBecause: They examine therapeutic strategies that exploit intrinsic tumor vulnerabilities, including hormone receptor dependence, cell cycle checkpoint losses, and defective DNA repair pathways.

topics.label: Oncogene Addiction and Kinase Inhibitors
topics.groupedBecause: They discuss targeted inhibition of oncogenic driver kinases alongside the mechanisms of resistance and drug addiction that develop during treatment.

topics.label: Monoclonal Antibodies and Antibody-Drug Conjugates
topics.groupedBecause: They cover the use of monoclonal antibodies and antibody-drug conjugates to selectively target cell surface antigens on tumor cells.

topics.label: Cancer Immunotherapy and T-Cell Engagement
topics.groupedBecause: They detail approaches to harnessing the host immune response against tumors, including immune checkpoint inhibition, neoantigen targeting, BiTEs, and CAR T-cell therapy.

topics.label: Challenges, Progress, and Future Directions in Cancer Treatment
topics.groupedBecause: They evaluate clinical challenges, historical improvements in patient survival, future therapeutic horizons, and ongoing treatment dilemmas in oncology.
